# Restricted Real-Data Fixtures

The following Feature 010 files are restricted to authorized collaborators in
this private repository:

- `france_2022-08-19_market_v1.json`
- `france_2022-08-19_activation_v1.json`
- `france_2022-08-19_expected_replay_v1.json`

They are not offered under the repository's Apache-2.0 license and must not be
published, packaged, released, copied to a public fork or mirror, or uploaded
to an external artifact service. Remove them before making the repository or
its relevant history public.

This restriction does not apply to the project-authored synthetic ENTSO-E XML
fixtures or manual arithmetic oracle. The complete handling policy and staging
workflow are in
`docs/migration/restricted-reference-fixtures.md`.
